name: Balsamic Sausage Lettuce Wraps with Zucchini, Bell Pepper & Lemon Mayo

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 medium zucchini squash
3 orange bell peppers
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter zucchini lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic, sausage, and spices; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly and veggies are tender, 6-7 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
0.68 kg ground pork sausage
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice lemons into a small bowl. Add mayo and spices, then whisk to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the sausage and veggies are done, add vinegar to the pot and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, separate the lettuce into leaves. Pile leaves, in stacks of two per wrap, onto plates; top with sausage and veggies. Drizzle with sauce and enjoy!
